name: solo-service-operations
description: Evidence-backed invoice preparation, follow-up, payment reconciliation and cash-flow planning from user-supplied records.

interface.longDescription: Prepare verified invoice documents from agreed terms and work evidence, reconcile payments and model cash with explicit uncertainty. No account connector or payment action is supplied.
defaultPrompt: Prepare an invoice review copy from my agreed terms and dated work evidence.
Reconcile these invoice and payment records.
Prepare follow-up drafts for these verified receivables.
